picks.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
picks.why: A rate hike priced as the base case would signal a turn in the Fed's policy cycle.

picks.question: Clarity Act (H.R.3633) signed into law in 2026?
picks.why: Crypto market-structure legislation would set rules for a fast-growing asset class and its banking links.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state one-time wealth tax would test capital mobility and revenue assumptions debated elsewhere.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Frontier-model leadership shapes AI capital spending, competition, and which firms capture the returns.

picks.question: Will Alibaba have the best Chinese AI model at the end of September 2026?
picks.why: Tracks which Chinese lab leads, a gauge of China's AI progress under export controls.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: An OpenAI listing at that valuation would show how public markets price AI expectations.
